content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Other conditions: Only female candidates are eligible to apply Candidate must be a permanent resident of Odisha Must have studied Odia as MIL up to 10th standard or passed an Odia language test of Matriculation standard conducted or recognised by BSE Odisha Date of birth will be considered as per High School Certificate Desirable: Preference will be given to widows, destitute women or divorcees with a valid certificate from a competent authority

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for Samagra Shiksha Bhadrak Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Incomplete and unsigned applications will be rejected Applications received after due date or by any other mode shall not be entertained

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Purely contractual and purely temporary engagement; can be terminated at any time On satisfactory completion of eleven months, engagement may be renewed after giving one day break There is no provision of ORV Act in case of engagement of staff in KGBV

content_sections.heading: How Will Samagra Shiksha Bhadrak Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Career evaluation Interview of shortlisted candidates Selection strictly on the basis of merit considering qualifications, followed by an interview Career evaluation; shortlisted candidates will appear for interview Preference to widow, destitute or divorcee women Original certificates to be produced at the time of document verification

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Self-attested Matric certificate and mark sheet Experience certificate of minimum 2 years in managing an academic institution issued by competent authority Residential certificate; Widow/Destitute/Divorcee certificate by competent authority (if any)

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Samagra Shiksha Bhadrak Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Download the application form (Annexure-A) from www.osepa.odisha.gov.in or bhadrak.odisha.gov.in. Fill the prescribed application format and affix photo. Enclose self-attested copies of all relevant documents. Address the envelope to District Project Coordinator, Samagra Shiksha, Bhadrak, At:-Upper Bagurai, Po:-Madhabanagar, Dist:-Bhadrak, Pin:-756181. Superscribe the envelope with "Application for the post of Warden". Send by Regd post/Speed post only to reach on or before 5.00 PM of 13-11-2026.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Samagra Shiksha Bhadrak Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 13 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Samagra Shiksha Bhadrak Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Warden.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for Samagra Shiksha Bhadrak Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Annexure-A attached to the notice (pages 2-3); also on www.osepa.odisha.gov.in and bhadrak.odisha.gov.in) and send it to District Project Coordinator, Samagra Shiksha, Bhadrak, At:-Upper Bagurai, Po:-Madhabanagar, Dist:-Bhadrak, Pin:-756181, by registered post or speed post only, to reach by 13 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is 30 to 50 years (as on date of advertisement).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs. 25,621 per month including EPF share of employee and employer.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: BA/BSc with B.Ed (untrained candidates considered if trained candidates are not available); minimum two years of experience in managing an academic institution; Odia up to 10th standard.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Only female candidates are eligible to apply. Candidate must be a permanent resident of Odisha. Must have studied Odia as MIL up to 10th standard or passed an Odia language test of Matriculation standard conducted or recognised by BSE Odisha. Date of birth will be considered as per High School Certificate.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Incomplete and unsigned applications will be rejected. Applications received after due date or by any other mode shall not be entertained.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Career evaluation. Interview of shortlisted candidates. Selection strictly on the basis of merit considering qualifications, followed by an interview. Career evaluation; shortlisted candidates will appear for interview.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Purely contractual and purely temporary engagement; can be terminated at any time. On satisfactory completion of eleven months, engagement may be renewed after giving one day break. There is no provision of ORV Act in case of engagement of staff in KGBV.
